CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content/presentation; 'candidate' labels are not an explicit attention relation here.

COD.rationale: The report lists an identified content (red coordinates) and an explicit origin/organization entry for the same referent/time, and the content and its origin/status are separately recorded.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement tied to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The text identifies represented contents with attributes (colour) and explicit coordinate values for named referents and times.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/representation-status metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The origin/represented_time metadata explicitly states how the content is organized/represented/accessed for the given referent/time.
